dogecoin.text:
These aren’t just tokens — they’re gas, governance, and glue.
Others are just pure vibes.
Yes, I’m talking about $DOGE, $PEPE, $SHIB
They’re memes with communities.
Some are jokes that became real money.
⚠️ Risky, but fun… if you know what you’re doing.

📌 Altcoin = “Alternative Coin”
Basically, anything that’s not BTC or ETH.
Think:
– $SOL
– $ADA
– $LINK
– $DOGE
– $MATIC
…even the meme ones 👀
Some altcoins actually power blockchains.
🔹 $SOL runs Solana
🔹 $MATIC scales Ethereum
🔹 $BNB runs Binance Smart Chain.
